title: CTAB DNA Extraction for Genotyping
author: Yaowu Yuan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3rrgm56

steps.title: Grind plant tissue
steps.instruction: Place fresh plant tissue (or silica‑gel dried tissue) in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add a few silica gel grains, and grind with liquid nitrogen until a fine powder is obtained.

steps.title: Add CTAB extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of CTAB DNA Extraction buffer to the ground tissue and mix.

steps.title: Incubate mixture at 55 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the CTAB/plant extract mixture for 15 minutes at 55 °C in a heat block, inverting the tube periodically to mix throughout the incubation.

steps.title: Add chloroform:isoamyl alcohol
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 500 µL of Chloroform : IsoAmyl Alcohol (24 : 1) to the tube and mix by inverting (do not vortex).

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase (~500 µL) to a new Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate and ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 7.5 M ammonium acetate, then add 500 µL of ice‑cold 100 % ethanol, and invert to mix.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a –20 °C freezer for 30 minutes (or longer) to precipitate the DNA.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 15 minutes (00:15:00) and observe the DNA pellet at the bottom.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet twice
steps.instruction: Perform two successive ethanol washes of the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge for 5 minutes (00:05:00).
Remove supernatant, add another 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Remove all supernatant and allow the DNA pellet to air‑dry in the hood for approximately 20 minutes (00:20:00), taking care not to over‑dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA pellet in 100 µL of dH₂O.

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load an aliquot of the DNA onto a 1.0 % agarose gel and run electrophoresis to assess DNA quality.
